name: Re-amp
description: Plays the sound through an amplifier and one of five loudspeakers in a room and records it again with a microphone you can pull back and turn away.

params.name: Speaker
params.description: Which loudspeaker the sound is played through. Small is a boxy little radio speaker, Combo an open guitar cabinet with a presence peak, Stack a closed cabinet with thump and scooped mids, Horn a honky public address horn, and Full range a nearly flat monitor for using the room alone.

params.name: Drive
params.description: How hard the amplifier is pushed. Low settings stay clean; higher ones round the peaks off, add valve harmonics and squash the dynamics, with the level held about where it was.

params.name: Bass
params.description: The amplifier's bass control, ahead of the valves. Up makes the breakup thicker and the cabinet thump; down keeps it tight.

params.name: Treble
params.description: The amplifier's treble control, ahead of the valves. Up adds bite and fizz to the breakup; down makes it rounder.

params.name: Distance
params.description: How far the microphone is from the speaker. At zero it is right on the cone, dry and close with a little extra bass. Pulling it back lets in the reflections and the tail of the room until the speaker is heard from the far side.

params.name: Room
params.description: The size of the room the speaker stands in, from a cupboard through a living room to a hall. Bigger rooms have later reflections and a longer tail. It is heard only once Distance is above zero.

params.name: Angle
params.description: Turns the microphone away from the centre of the cone. Off to the side the direct sound is duller and the speaker's presence peak softens.

params.name: Noise
params.description: The amplifier's own hiss and a faint mains hum, louder when Drive is up. It sounds only while signal is passing and for a moment after, so silence stays silent.

params.name: Output
params.description: Level of the recorded sound. The dry part of Mix is not affected.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched signal and the re-amped one. Part way layers the speaker in the room under the clean sound.
